title: Batch import
purpose: Map and validate CSV or Excel laboratory data before an atomic commit to the active site.
noLabMessage: Imports must have an explicit destination laboratory.
noLabHelp: Choose the target laboratory before selecting a file.
destinationBody: All accepted rows will be assigned to {{code}}. A failed commit rolls back the entire batch; the source file is never modified.
antibioticCapBody: The catalogue reached 10,000 entries; some per-antibiotic mapping targets may be truncated.
dropTitle: Select a CSV or Excel workbook
dropBody: Supported: .xlsx, .xls, .xlsb, .csv, .tsv and delimited text. Protected or malformed workbooks are reported without partial ingestion.
orTemplate: or start with the master-aware template
profileModalDescription: Stores the current column mapping, delimiter and default row state for this laboratory.
mappingIntro: Confirm how each source column maps to a canonical field. Choose “Do not import” for irrelevant columns.
revalidateBody: The source mapping or import defaults have not been validated in their current form. Apply mapping and revalidate before commit.

issues.title: Validation issues
issues.description: Errors must be resolved before commit; warnings may be retained as draft records.

previewDescription: First {{count}} parsed rows; no data is committed yet.

commit.locked: Commit is locked until the visible mapping, delimiter and defaults pass preview again.

history.title: Import history
history.description: Recent auditable import operations for this installation.
history.emptyMessage: Completed and failed import attempts will be recorded here.

help.pipeline: The import pipeline separates parsing, mapping, validation and commit. Review the preview and issue list before writing anything to the database.
help.atomicityBody: A commit uses one transaction. If any database write fails, the batch is rolled back rather than leaving a partial import.
help.astBody: Use the generated template for the most predictable antibiotic-column mapping. Unrecognised columns are never guessed into a different field without showing the mapping.
